description: This file contains benchmark tests for the absl crc32c functions, including performance measurements for computing, extending, concatenating, and manipulating CRC32C checksums, using the Google Benchmark framework.

methods.name: TestString
methods.description: Generates a string of specified length with sequential byte values for testing purposes.

methods.name: BM_Calculate
methods.description: Benchmark for computing CRC32C checksum of a string.

methods.name: BM_Extend
methods.description: Benchmark for extending a CRC32C checksum with additional data.

methods.name: BM_ExtendCacheMiss
methods.description: Benchmark for extending CRC32C with a large data set to simulate cache misses.

methods.name: BM_ExtendByZeroes
methods.description: Benchmark for extending CRC32C checksum by a number of zero bytes.

methods.name: BM_UnextendByZeroes
methods.description: Benchmark for unextending CRC32C checksum by a number of zero bytes.

methods.name: BM_Concat
methods.description: Benchmark for concatenating two CRC32C checksums.

methods.name: BM_Memcpy
methods.description: Benchmark for computing CRC32C checksum via memory copy.

methods.name: BM_RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Benchmark for removing a suffix CRC from a full string CRC.
